notes:
New
- Comment on selected text in Docs. Select text, then right-click and choose Add comment, or press
  ⌘⌥M. Comments open in a panel beside the document, where you can reply, edit or delete your own
  comments, and resolve or reopen a thread. Viewers can comment too, and comments you write offline
  are sent when you reconnect.
- Sweetheart can ask to switch the to-do list it is working in, or hand the list back, when a
  request belongs elsewhere.

Fixed
- Scrollbars follow the app's light or dark theme.
- Choosing which Facebook page or Instagram account to publish to loads again, saving the choice and
  Remove sign-in work, and the Meta setup fields link to where each value is found.
